title: Listen and Choose a Response — Club Event

questions.stem: Haven't you met our new club president yet?

options.A: The club meets every Wednesday evening.
options.B: Not yet. Could you introduce us?
options.C: Yes, I'll meet the president next week.

questions.explanation: Saying not yet and asking for an introduction is natural; the 'Yes' option contradicts having met.
